reasoning: This is a standalone HTTP gateway service written in Rust (axum/tokio). It listens on a configurable port (default 8090), exposes dynamic /v1/chat/completions endpoints per configured route, and proxies requests to the FMS Guardrails Orchestrator while enforcing detector pipelines for guardrailing LLM outputs. It is containerized (Dockerfile with a UBI-based release image) and runs as a long-lived network service. It is not an operator (no Kubernetes controller/reconciler logic, no CRDs), not a library (it produces a binary, not a crate consumed by others), and not pure configuration. It is a reverse-proxy/gateway service that sits between clients and the orchestrator to enforce guardrails policies.
